newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arab Druze wound 17 policemen in Jerusalem clash.
newsitem.headline: Arab Druze wound 17 policemen in Jerusalem clash.

text.p: Arab Druze stoned and wounded 17 border policemen during a Jerusalem protest on Sunday, assailing an Israeli court ruling they said discriminated against them in favour of wildlife.
Police said the policemen were lightly wounded along with four demonstrators in violence outside the High Court of Justice before the policemen, many of them also Druze, broke up the protest.
The protest erupted after a three-judge court ordered a road be temporarily blocked pending a final ruling on allegations by Israeli environmentalists the road illegally crossed a wildlife preserve.
The Druze said they had paved an 800-metre (-yard) stretch of the road to connect the Druze villages of Beit Jann and Horfish in Upper Galilee, population 9,000 and 6,000 respectively.
"To raise mice and snakes in the nature preserves authority, they are ready to uproot this entire people and throw it out of the country," one of the demonstrators complained to reporters.
The Druze -- a secretive offshoot of Islam -- number more than 60,000 in Israel. They are the only non-Jewish minority who must serve in Israel's army but have complained at times of discrimination.
